text:
claire: Starting a follow-up thread from the postmortem — focus: vendor/dependency outage mitigations and owners. Reply with ack + item.

marc: Ack. Drop the list and I'll pick what fits my sprint.

claire: Items I extracted: 1) orchestration-level fallback (multi-cloud artifact mirror + failover playbook); 2) model-registry auth graceful degradation + short-term cache + telemetry; 3) auth provider token refresh mutex + health check; 4) vendor contract ask: faster eng escalation + incident credits language; 5) add monthly recurrence analytics + runbook drill schedule; 6) ensure audit logs for vendor calls are preserved for 90d for RCA.

zane: I'll take (2) and (3) together. Plan: add an in-memory LRU manifest cache with 2m TTL and implement single-flight token refresh in the client lib. Also emit a structured event when serving cached manifests. ETA: branch by 2026-03-29.

claire: @zane add integration tests that simulate auth spikes and model-registry 503s.

zane: Will do.

marc: I'll own (1) orchestration fallback + failover playbook. Short-term: manual failover runbook + one-click toggle to switch to mirror; medium-term: automated failover based on latency/error thresholds. ETA runbook draft: 2026-04-06.

devops-bot: Created follow-up ticket INC-2026-620 and linked watchers.

vendor-eng: For (4) I'm confirming primary + manager contacts for provider-C and I'll request a P1 engagement SLA. Draft escalation card and email template by 2026-03-24.

legal: We'll draft "incident credit" language and loop in vendor-eng for negotiation. Target sharing draft by 2026-03-31.

claire: For (5) recurring analytics: we need a dashboard that surfaces top recurring root causes and vendor hit counts over 30/90/180d. Someone to build a staging panel?

marc: I can spin up the Grafana panel in staging and wire datasource to the postmortem table. ETA: 2026-04-02.

claire: For (6) audit logs, infra note: ensure vendor call traces are forwarded to long-term storage with tenant anonymization. Who owns?

zane: I'll add a small shim in the client to copy request/response hashes (no PII) to our elk stream and set retention to 90d. ETA: 2026-03-30.

marc: Risk note: the mirror approach may lag artifact propagation. Add a reconcile job that verifies checksums after failover. I'll include that in the runbook.

claire: Owners recap: zane (cache + token mutex + logs) -> 2026-03-30/2026-03-29; marc (mirror runbook + reconcile + dashboard) -> 2026-04-06/2026-04-02; vendor-eng (escalation card) -> 2026-03-24; legal (contract wording) -> 2026-03-31.

devops-bot: Reminder: recurring incident-pattern review meeting created for 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC.

vendor-eng: Contact card added to INC-2026-620 and initial outreach sent to provider-C.

zane: Draft PR for single-flight token refresh pushed: https://git.internal/p/sf-token-refresh (WIP). Will link to ticket.

marc: Runbook draft uploaded to INC-2026-620.

claire: Thanks everyone. Please add PRs/tickets to INC-2026-620 and react with :white_check_mark: when linked. We'll review progress in the monthly triage if not sooner.
